title: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future/The Songs
text:
Song of the Turtle 

Turtles will follow you if you sing them this song. Even turtles that are hiding in their shell will poke their heads out and move when sung this song.

 Song of the Shark 

Sharks will be stunned with the sound of your sonar. This allows you to attack them head-on in your attack while they are stunned. 

 Song of the Fish 

Small schools of fish will surround you and follow. This can be very useful to you as a particular type of fish may provide you with illumination while another may provide you with protection when you swim with them. Just know that all fish move slowly, so don't move too fast if you want the school of fish to follow you!

 Song of the Ray 

Using the Song of Ray allows Ecco to prod the GReat Manta Ray in the direction Ecco wants him to move. Ecco can do this by aiming his Sonar. Hidden stingrays will move when sung this song, while those in plain sight will flee. 

 Song of the Plant 

Causes one type of plant to release a cloud of ink and another to emit sounds while swaying, creating a diversion to confuse foes.
